summary: Backend testing for WhatsApp manual upgrade flow + regression. 24/24 pytest tests PASS. Fixed one critical MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in /api/payments/request-upgrade.

critical.issue: First-call returned 500 (TypeError: ObjectId not iterable). insert_one mutated req_doc adding _id, causing FastAPI JSON serialization to fail. Idempotent 2nd call worked because it re-fetched without _id. FIXED by adding req_doc.pop('_id', None) after insert.

minor.issue: Duplicate function definition in server.py (lines 838-850). Second definition is dead code (no decorator) but creates code smell.
proof_image accepted as query param (not body) since no Pydantic model used. Inconsistent with upload-proof which uses body. Works but unusual API surface.

action_items: Remove duplicate my_upgrade_request function definition at lines 847-850 of server.py
Consider moving proof_image in request-upgrade to a Pydantic body model for API consistency
critical_code_review_comments: Critical bug: insert_one mutating req_doc with ObjectId caused 500. Pattern repeats throughout codebase - any insert_one followed by returning the doc must pop _id. Audit other inserts.
Duplicate function definitions for /payments/my-request (harmless but confusing).
request-upgrade endpoint uses query param for proof_image instead of JSON body - inconsistent.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (one-line fix: pop _id after insert in request-upgrade)
test_credentials: admin@famly.id / admin123 (works). Test users use TEST_*@famlytest.com (note: .test TLD is reserved by Pydantic EmailStr and rejected).
seed_data_creation: Test fixture creates ephemeral TEST_*@famlytest.com users plus families/expenses/tasks/upgrade-requests. Settings normalized to 6281234567890 / 6281299998888 during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 24 backend tests pass. Verified: settings GET/PUT + phone normalization (08xx->62xx, strips + spaces dashes), request-upgrade (503 when empty, wa.me URL with code+name+email+Rp 49.000, idempotency), upload-proof (413 over 2.8MB, 404 no pending), my-request (no proof_image field, null when none), admin list/proof/approve/reject (approve grants 30d premium + creates payment_transactions with payment_status=manual_wa, double-approve 400, reject does NOT grant). All regression flows still pass.
rca of the issue: RCA for /api/payments/request-upgrade 500: motor's insert_one mutates the inserted dict in place adding MongoDB-generated _id (ObjectId). The endpoint then returned that mutated dict, which FastAPI's JSON encoder cannot serialize (ObjectId has no __dict__). Reproduction: any first-time call by a new user. Mitigation applied: added req_doc.pop('_id', None) immediately after insert_one. Verified by re-running full pytest suite (24/24 pass).
